protocol.name: Secure Frame (SFrame)
notes: SFrame provides end-to-end encryption/authentication for real-time media while allowing SFUs to process routing metadata without media plaintext.
Key management is intentionally external to the media framing; E2EESA profiles select RFC 9605 sender-key or MLS key management.
Each (base_key, KID, CTR) combination may be used for at most one encryption operation.

cipher_suites.name: AES_128_CTR_HMAC_SHA256_32
cipher_suites.status_reason: 32-bit authentication tags are too short for new E2EESA real-time-media deployments.

pending_updates.note: May 2026 Internet-Draft adds AES-256-CTR/HMAC-SHA512 suites 0x0006-0x0008. E2EESA will not treat draft-only registrations as stable until standardized.
